title: A Study of Flt3-Ligand Levels in Sjögrens Syndrome
brief_summary: The study aims to correlate levels of Flt3-ligand in Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) and serum to markers for inflammation and degeneration in patients with primary Sjogrens syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* fulfill the ACR-criteria for primary Sjogrens syndrome,
* age above 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* other CNS-disease
study_population: The rheumatology clinic at Sahlgrenska University hospital, Gothenburg, Sweden
